headline: Western Washington concede six goals in twenty-two matches
dek: Western Washington kept a clean sheet against Cal Poly Pomona, the side that had beaten Simon Fraser in September and again in November. It was their seventeenth win in twenty-two matches; they have lost two, and they sit top of the conference table.
